race.comment: THE DESTROYER (12) went so much better second time around. Easy to see her improve again and prove to be a big chance in this type of race. HE'S FIERCE (1) is another who has been racing with consistency without grabbing a win. He was getting a long way back before a spell. Had two trials in the lead up. SATOSHI (10) always shows pace in his races. Should be thereabouts in this class of maiden. PRESTIGE HELLBENT (9) was OK at Hamilton. Has been about the same each time.
